howItWorks.title: How does it work?
howItWorks.intro: Each payment is split in three parts, one for each kind of spending:
howItWorks.needs: What you can't skip: rent, food, utilities and transport.
howItWorks.wants: What isn't essential: eating out, going out, personal shopping and subscriptions.
howItWorks.savings: What you keep: emergency fund, long-term goals or paying debts early.
howItWorks.yours: The classic rule is 50 / 30 / 20, but this calculator uses your split. Change it in More → Budget.
